rationale: David brings deep production robotics expertise from shipping autonomous systems at Skycatch and Agtonomy, plus conviction that real-time infrastructure is foundational for the next generation of robotics—a perspective grounded in a decade of end-to-end autonomous systems work. Jonah is a founder and CTO with venture-launching experience; while his technical focus isn't fully characterized in available data, his founding background and technical leadership could benefit from David's rare vantage point on production robotics challenges and infrastructure gaps.
intro_message: David Chen, meet Jonah Sargent — David's spent a decade shipping autonomous systems and is now building real-time infrastructure at LiveKit specifically for production robotics, and Jonah's a founder/CTO who might find his perspective on robotics production challenges valuable for your work.
